label: OpenTelemetry
description: Ship every run of this tree to an OpenTelemetry collector as spans. Nothing is instrumented by an author: the report a run already leaves is the trace, and a project's startup list names `export` to send it. A tree that names no step exports nothing, so a reader of project.json sees at the root whether traces leave the process, to where, and under which service name.

endpoint.description: the OTLP/HTTP collector to POST spans to, e.g. http://localhost:4318/v1/traces; a {{secrets.<key>}} read where the collector is not public

service.description: what this tree is called on a span: the service.name every exported span carries

headers.description: headers to send with every export, for a collector that authenticates, e.g. "x-api-key": "{{secrets.OTLP_KEY}}"

level.description: how much a span carries: "summary" (the default) is status, timing and the wilanis.* attributes and never a value; "full" adds the report's redacted in/out and a node's message

flushDeadlineMs.description: the most stopping waits for the last spans to reach the collector, in milliseconds; past it what is still unsent is said in one log line and dropped, and the process goes on stopping. Absent: 2000, which lets a collector that answers at all take the last batch and leaves most of the 10 s a container is given after SIGTERM to everything else that stops, where a collector that cannot be reached would otherwise hold the stop for the ~9 s its exporter spends retrying
